text:
Faye (PM): dropping a short design check for the private setup preflight. key asks: how explicit should the "why" be inline, and what's the least scary failure tone? figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder (frame 'preflight-friendly')

Omar (Design): propose a small inline 'Why' dropdown per-host that surfaces 2-3 likely causes + one suggested command. keeps the row clean but gives quick next steps.

Pia (Eng): agree on inline 'Why'. we can surface a probationary confidence score like 'Likely: firewall (70%)' but keep it human readable — no raw ML terms. include a copyable cmd: `nc -vz <HOST> <PORT>` and a tiny hint 'run from a host on same VPC'.

Lee (A11y): accessibility: ensure the 'Why' panel is reachable via keyboard and announced with role=region and an accessible label. soften failure language: use "Checks need attention" not 'failed' in the top summary.

Faye (PM): for the progress indicator, instead of a single bar per-scan, show 'checked X/Y' plus a small active-host badge. avoids false precision.

Omar (Design): visual: use a neutral banner 'Checks finished - 3 reachable, 2 need attention' with amber icon when partial. keep red only for explicit blocking errors. add a 'Show troubleshooting flow' CTA linking KB.

Pia (Eng): technical: limit auto-retries to 3 attempts and add exponential backoff. show 'Retry now' per-host micro button and a disabled state 'Retry in 28s' when capped. server will return retryAllowed boolean to reflect rate limits.

Lee (A11y): announce final summary in an aria-live polite region and move focus to the summary when the scan completes. avoid announcing each host change. copy buttons must announce success: 'Copied command'.

ci-bot: preview build -> https://deploy/preview/9999 (staging)

Faye (PM): action items: Omar will add the inline 'Why' panel and neutral banner, Pia will wire retryAllowed/cooldown display, Lee will draft A11y notes. I'll update figma and post the preview. Thanks!
